# Veritrail Documentation

> Documentation for Veritrail, an audit-readiness scanning platform. Veritrail connects read-only to cloud accounts, source-control organizations, and identity providers, scans continuously, maps findings to the framework controls they support, and exports signed, auditor-ready evidence packs.

## Product summary

- Frameworks: SOC 2, ISO 27001, CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark.
- Connectors: AWS, Google Cloud, Azure, GitHub, GitLab, Microsoft Entra ID, Google Workspace.
- Scanning-only and read-only: no write access, no PassRole, no agents. Veritrail never modifies your environment; it provides remediation guidance and re-checks fixes on demand with Verify fix.
- Evidence packs carry SHA-256 checksums for every file and an Ed25519 signature over the checksum manifest.
- Findings support framework controls — Veritrail does not guarantee compliance or certification outcomes.

## Docs sections (all on https://docs.veritrail.io/)

- Getting started: Introduction, Quickstart, How it works
- Connect sources: AWS, Google Cloud, Azure, GitHub & GitLab, Microsoft Entra ID, Google Workspace
- Evidence: Controls & mapping, Evidence packs, Narrative PDF report, Auditor portal, Scheduled exports
- Reference: Security & access, FAQ
